Interface ListItem

All Known Subinterfaces:
AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.ListItem0
public interface ListItem
Marker interface for items displayed in SwingSet list and combobox components. An Listem is converted to a String for display with ListItemFormat. An Listem contains an ordered list of elements; each elem has an associated elemIndex which is typically opaque. Access to these elements is typically handled through sub-classes of AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.

Compatible with GlazedLists AutoComplete feature.
